approved_scope: Step 4A feasibility and offline design only

reserve.activation: separate approval required; never automatic fallback

initial_step4b.extra_case_activation: requires new explicit case-list and request-budget approval

pre_upload_gate: approve exact provider, model, two image hashes, terms and $0 budget

verify operator age 18+, eligible client audience (not directed toward or likely accessed by under-18s), region and actual unbilled project tier; free clients in EEA/Switzerland/UK are not eligible under current terms
verify active model quota in AI Studio; no assumption from advertised free tier
confirm each crop has no identifying/personal/confidential material and approve external reuse of public research images
load credential from environment only; do not read .env, print or commit keys
audit exact image-only payload and metadata stripping; never include references, expected geometry or grader answers
method_order: 4B VLM-only observations -> strict semantic validation -> Photo Geometry v1; no native integration
4C local OCR-assisted CV on exact same image bytes; no VLM outputs fed into CV-only arm
4D separately approved VLM guidance + shape-preserving CV, same bytes and independent evaluation
4E choose and integrate observed winner with existing StarNative adapter

representation.graph_coordinates: computed locally only after two consistent numeric tick anchors per axis and known intersection values; otherwise null
representation.provenance: sidecar method/provider/model/request/image/code hashes; calibration source photo_detected or explicit student_corrected
representation.isolated_points: cannot be imported by v1 stroke-only adapter; retain in observation sidecar, flag unsupported and needs_review/abstained; never drop silently or connect

evaluation.existing_cases: two prior failures; exploratory approximate visual references, not independent accuracy
evaluation.same_input_requirement: identical original crop hashes, dimensions and source pixel frame for all arms; all preprocessing transforms recorded and inverted

pending_independent_cases.reference_creation: human draws then annotates visible ink without equations, prompts or AI proposals; freeze before inference

metrics: correct independent branch count and qualitative connectivity
per-branch reference coverage at <=3 native pixels; <10% missing, 10%-90% partial
reference-to-prediction and prediction-to-reference p95 point-to-segment distance
endpoint and marked-corner distances; gaps and extrema reviewed on overlay
axis origin, per-axis sign/unit scale, numeric tick false labels and abstentions
student corrections with count/type/time, measured in later UI integration
raw request latency, usage and actual cost when returned; unknown stays null
native import not_run_until_4E; end-to-end acceptance in 4F

decision_gate.engineering_fidelity_screen: all branches present, no invented joins/gaps, >=90% coverage per branch and <=5px p95 in both directions, <=5px endpoint/corner errors where annotated
decision_gate.calibration_screen: both unit vectors and origin independently supported; <=5% unit-length and <=3px origin error only when independent reference exists; otherwise qualitative/unknown
decision_gate.tolerance_caveat: new exploratory screen, not validated grading threshold; also report existing <=3px coverage unchanged; approximate references can make numeric pass/fail uncertain
decision_gate.primary_selection: real-photo fidelity, then correction burden, reliability/privacy and latency; JSON validity alone cannot select
decision_gate.approval_reviewer: human reviews original/reference/prediction overlays and uncertainty; no automatic accuracy claim

required_step4b_artifacts: per-case raw provider response and failure record
schema and semantic validation report; no code-fence repair/coercion
validated Photo Geometry v1 or explicit unscorable/abstained status
request/response hashes, provider/model identifiers, usage/latency/cost records
self-review, local commit, clean-tree verification and explicit Step4C approval request
failure_policy: stop on missing permission/credential/tier confirmation, charge risk, quota, timeout, invalid JSON or geometry; record failure and commit useful work; no retry, switch or fabricated prediction
deadline_policy: By Nov 6 choose based on actual evidence. Recommend skipping reserve-provider/local-model comparison and, if VLM-only suffices, skipping or combining 4C/4D only after explicit approval to change checkpoints. Preserve 4E/4F time; if access blocked, document assisted/manual fallback as fallback, not automatic recognition success.
